comment: Stage 8 chat regression cases. tools/hf_chat_reference.py runs them through Hugging Face (golden), edgeforge verify-chat through our engines. 'default' must equal kDefaultSystemPrompt in include/ef/chat.h.

systems.default: You are a helpful assistant. Give one short, direct reply to the user's message.

cases.name: fact_capital
turns: What is the capital of France?

cases.name: fact_boiling
turns: At what temperature does water boil at sea level?

cases.name: explain_cache
turns: Explain what a CPU cache is in two sentences.

cases.name: code_max
turns: Write a C function that returns the larger of two integers.
